subject: Aventus CAIQ: tenant boundary clarification + evidence list
messages:
From: Lydia Park <lydia.park@aventushealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jamal Rivers <jamal.rivers@aventushealth.com>, procure@aventushealth.com
Date: 2026-08-08T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: CAIQ mapping + tenant boundary question for Aventus onboarding

Hi Vanessa —

Thanks again for the walkthrough this morning. Aventus would like to proceed with a CAIQ-style mapping before we finalize procurement. Two quick clarifications so our security and procurement teams can scope the ask: 

1) Tenant/scope boundary: we need confirmation about which Redwood-hosted surfaces are in-scope for our review. Specifically: production inference endpoints, the private dedicated pool for our tenant, and any telemetry exported to Redwood analytics. Please confirm if staging/test environments are excluded by default.

2) Evidence list: our SOC/CIS team will need a small set of runnable artifacts for sampling — e.g., an example KV cache access log, an auth rotation snapshot, and an annotated crosswalk that shows which CAIQ control maps to which Redwood artifact. Can you provide a short list of attachments you can deliver and an estimated delivery date?

We'd also like to get the signature roster for DocuSign so we can route internally. Jamal (cc) is the security lead — he and I will coordinate procurement.

Thanks,
Lydia Park
Senior InfoSec Manager | Aventus Health
--
Aventus Health
lydia.park@aventushealth.com
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Lydia Park <lydia.park@aventushealth.com>
Cc: Jamal Rivers <jamal.rivers@aventushealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-08T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ mapping + tenant boundary question for Aventus onboarding

Hi Lydia —

Thanks — this is straightforward and happy to run the mapping. Quick answers up front:
- Tenant boundary: we will scope PROD (prod) and the dedicated tenant pool (tenant: aventus-prod). Staging/test clusters are excluded unless you explicitly request them. Telemetry to Redwood analytics is in-scope for the CAIQ controls that reference telemetry/monitoring; we will annotate those entries.

- Evidence we can provide in the initial delivery: 
  * redwood_caiq_crosswalk-v1.xlsx (draft crosswalk, control-by-control notes)
  * kv-cache-log-sample.txt (redacted KV access sample — 24-hour slice)
  * tenant-scope-diagram.png (network/tenant boundary diagram)
  * auth-rotation-statement.txt (runbook excerpt + rotation timestamp)

I'm copying Marissa to help pull the artifacts and Ben for the trace/log sample. Proposed delivery: initial draft crosswalk + diagram by 2026-08-10 COB, log/sample artifacts by 2026-08-12. Does that timeline work for you?

Next steps: once you confirm the scope above, we'll upload the package to a secured share and open a DocuSign envelope for the CAIQ attestation. Please confirm the signers and their emails so we can pre-populate the envelope.

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-08T12:45:00-07:00
Subject: Draft crosswalk + artifact inventory for Aventus CAIQ (internal)

Vanessa / Marissa —

Attaching my initial artifacts for the Aventus package. High level notes below and gaps to call out: 

Attachments included as part of upload: redwood_caiq_crosswalk-v1.xlsx (control-level sheet + notes), tenant-scope-diagram.png, kv-cache-log-sample.txt (24-hour redacted lines), auth-rotation-statement.txt.

Gaps/asks:
- CSA control CMA-1 (key lifecycle): need a signer-confirmed KMS rotation report (I have a runbook excerpt but not the signed rotation ticket).
- CSA control MON-2 (telemetry retention): need to confirm retention policy window for Aventus tenant (default is 90 days) — Marissa, can you confirm if Aventus requested less than default?
- Evidence format: the procurement team asked for DocuSign-ready artifact checklist. I can populate the envelope once procurement confirms the signature roster.

I also left short inline comments in the crosswalk for items where we are using compensating controls (e.g., rate-limiting for certain dataflow assertions).

Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Compliance Engineer | Redwood Inference

Related link (internal): DocuSign envelope template: https://docusign.com/envelope/XYZ-998877
From: Lydia Park <lydia.park@aventushealth.com>

Date: 2026-08-08T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ mapping + tenant boundary question for Aventus onboarding

Vanessa / Ben —

Thanks — that timeline works for Aventus. Confirming signers for DocuSign: 
- Lydia Park (InfoSec Manager) — lydia.park@aventushealth.com
- Jamal Rivers (Head of Security) — jamal.rivers@aventushealth.com
- Procurement (AVT Procure) — procure@aventushealth.com

A couple of clarifications:
- Telemetry retention: default 90 days is acceptable for us; we will note that in the CAIQ.
- KMS rotation: we can accept the runbook excerpt for now but will request the rotation ticket if the auditor asks for a signed event. Please mark that as an optional follow-up item in the crosswalk.

Please upload the draft package to the secure share and ping Jamal once DocuSign is ready.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

— Lydia
